message: The other day, I found myself caught in a sudden rainstorm while out with the grandkids. My phone, of course, decided to die just when I needed it to navigate us home. We ended up huddling under a tree, laughing and playing a little game to pass the time until the rain let up. It reminded me how important it is to have a plan B... and maybe a good old-fashioned map tucked away in my go-bag! 📜 Have you ever had a tech fail at a crucial moment?
